# Ireland MCP

Ireland MCP is a public, read-only Model Context Protocol server for Irish public data. It needs no API key, account or login.

Endpoint: https://func-ireland-mcp-aofsjpwgy4hva.azurewebsites.net/mcp
Future endpoint: https://mcp.irishopendata.ie/mcp
Transport: Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC over POST
Auth: none
Default tool surface: 7 tools, 5,241 characters, about 1.3k tokens on this branch
Full surface: use ?toolsets=all only when a client needs all typed tools listed

Install:
- Claude connector: add a custom connector named Ireland MCP with the endpoint URL and no authentication.
- ChatGPT: enable Developer Mode connectors, create an MCP connector, use the endpoint URL and no authentication.
- VS Code: vscode://mcp/install?%7B%22ireland%22%3A%7B%22type%22%3A%22http%22%2C%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Ffunc-ireland-mcp-aofsjpwgy4hva.azurewebsites.net%2Fmcp%22%7D%7D
- VS Code Insiders: vscode-insiders://mcp/install?%7B%22ireland%22%3A%7B%22type%22%3A%22http%22%2C%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Ffunc-ireland-mcp-aofsjpwgy4hva.azurewebsites.net%2Fmcp%22%7D%7D
- Cursor: cursor://anysphere.cursor-deeplink/mcp/install?name=ireland&config=eyJ0eXBlIjoiaHR0cCIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vZnVuYy1pcmVsYW5kLW1jcC1hb2ZzanB3Z3k0aHZhLmF6dXJld2Vic2l0ZXMubmV0L21jcCJ9
- Copilot CLI: copilot mcp add --transport http ireland https://func-ireland-mcp-aofsjpwgy4hva.azurewebsites.net/mcp
- Claude Code: claude mcp add --transport http ireland https://func-ireland-mcp-aofsjpwgy4hva.azurewebsites.net/mcp
- Local stdio: npm package target `npx -y ireland-mcp` after npm publication; today use `npm ci && npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js` from source.

Default tools:
- ireland_catalogue: compact domain/source/operation catalogue.
- ireland_describe: arguments and metadata for one source/operation.
- ireland_call: execute an operation by source and operation name; cite returned source/licence metadata.
- ireland_about: server, policy and citation guidance.
- search: cross-source search.
- fetch: fetch an ireland:// resource or search hit.
- nearby: place-aware shortcut.

Toolsets:
- Default is lean.
- All tools: add ?toolsets=all.
- One source: /mcp/x/{source-id} or ?toolsets={source-id}.

Source domains: stats, law/politics, places/property, environment, transport, energy and economy. Data remains under each publisher licence; responses include source and licence metadata where available. Privacy notes are in PRIVACY.md.
